_note: Scripted scenarios for serve.py --llm-script (M4R step 3 capture/repro). The agent loop, tools and graph are real; only the model's next-move choices are canned. Run: python scripts/serve.py --http-port 8789 --llm-script docs/demo/m4r/ask-script.json. Numbers in the final texts were read from the live repo:flask graph when the script was written.

scenarios.content:
25 callers, all within one hop: 12 in tests/test_basic.py, 4 in the tutorial's auth.py, and 9 more across blog.py and two other test modules. Nothing under src/flask calls url_for internally — its blast radius is the public contract itself, so the examples and the test suite break first.

helpers.py itself keeps moving (latest: "drop support for Python 3.10"), but url_for's call surface is small and stable.

wsgi_app makes three direct calls, all inside app.py: full_dispatch_request (the real work), handle_exception, and request_context. app.py's recent history is small maintenance — "fix dev", "fix docs ref", "fix typos" — the dispatch path itself hasn't churned.
